'''2020 TMW Pods Patrick Johnson LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Patrick Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
